import os, sys, json, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from rcb_client import Robot
os.makedirs('/app/output/observations', exist_ok=True)
print('Connecting to RoboLab service...', flush=True)
r = Robot(timeout=600)
spec = r.spec()
print('CONNECTED', r.base, 'protocol=', spec.get('protocol'), flush=True)
print('SPEC_KEYS', list(spec), flush=True)
print('BUDGET', spec.get('budget'), flush=True)
print('ROBOT', json.dumps(spec.get('robot_spec',{}), indent=2), flush=True)
print('CAMERAS', json.dumps(spec.get('cameras',{}), indent=2), flush=True)
print('WORLD', json.dumps(spec.get('world',{}), indent=2), flush=True)
obs = r.get_obs(depth=True, video='frames')
print('META', json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2)[:12000], flush=True)
for c, im in obs.last.items(): Image.fromarray(im).save(f'/app/output/observations/initial_{c}.png')
for c, d in obs.last_depth.items(): np.save(f'/app/output/observations/initial_depth_{c}.npy',d)
print('INITIAL', list(obs.last), flush=True)

def snap(name='latest', depth=True):
    global obs
    obs = r.get_obs(depth=depth, video='frames')
    for c, im in obs.last.items(): Image.fromarray(im).save(f'/app/output/observations/{name}_{c}.png')
    if depth:
        for c,d in obs.last_depth.items(): np.save(f'/app/output/observations/{name}_depth_{c}.npy',d)
    print('OBS', name, 'left_s=',obs.meta.get('time_left_s'), 'now=',obs.meta.get('proprio',{}).get('now'), flush=True)
    return obs

def ee(points, video='mp4', dt=None, **kw):
    global res, obs
    res = r.submit('ee_pose', np.asarray(points,dtype=np.float32), video=video, **({} if dt is None else {'dt':dt}), **kw)
    res.save('/app/output/observations/last_result')
    print('RESULT done=',res.done,'reason=',res.meta.get('reason'),'plan=',res.meta.get('plan'),'clipped=',res.meta.get('clipped'),'steps=',res.meta.get('control_steps_chunk'),'left_s=',res.meta.get('time_left_s'),flush=True)
    if res.last:
        for c,im in res.last.items(): Image.fromarray(im).save(f'/app/output/observations/post_{c}.png')
    return res

def jp(points, dt=0.2, video='mp4', **kw):
    global res
    res=r.submit('joint_position',np.asarray(points,dtype=np.float32),dt=dt,video=video,**kw)
    print('RESULT done=',res.done,'reason=',res.meta.get('reason'),'plan=',res.meta.get('plan'),'clipped=',res.meta.get('clipped'),'steps=',res.meta.get('control_steps_chunk'),'left_s=',res.meta.get('time_left_s'),flush=True)
    if res.last:
        for c,im in res.last.items(): Image.fromarray(im).save(f'/app/output/observations/post_{c}.png')
    return res

def pose(): return obs.meta['proprio']['now'][10:17]
def qnow(): return np.array(obs.meta['proprio']['now'][:7])
print('READY', flush=True)
